clauses.reason: Each information, funding, support, appointment, and FACA instruction is expressly for this Council or its functions. None directs a separate post-Council program. The appropriation qualifier is not a cessation event. Travel rights for work already performed are accounted for as accrued effects rather than a continuing council mandate. Original section 3(e) would terminate the Council after two years. EO12783 expressly substitutes termination on January 16, 1993; that fixed termination command controls, rather than the original 1992 anniversary or the later 1993 formal revocation. No amendment effective date is inferred from its signing date. EO12869 expressly recognizes EO12720 as amended by EO12783 and revokes it effective September 30, 1993.

research_rationale:
Independent producer B review of the frozen full dossier and held original/actor source texts. Original section 3(e) would terminate the Council after two years. EO12783 expressly substitutes termination on January 16, 1993; that fixed termination command controls, rather than the original 1992 anniversary or the later 1993 formal revocation. No amendment effective date is inferred from its signing date. EO12869 expressly recognizes EO12720 as amended by EO12783 and revokes it effective September 30, 1993. The corrected nine-part inventory includes the original establishment, appointments, both advisory functions, information duty, compensation/travel, support/funding, FACA delegation, and sunset. The OCR joined section 3(d) into 3(c); exact disjoint original-source spans now separate them. The fixed sunset reaches the Council and its continuing institutional machinery; the later formal revocation reaches the entire order. Each information, funding, support, appointment, and FACA instruction is expressly for this Council or its functions. None directs a separate post-Council program. The appropriation qualifier is not a cessation event. Travel rights for work already performed are accounted for as accrued effects rather than a continuing council mandate. No express prospective saving appears in EO12783 or EO12869 for this Council. Section 3(b) nevertheless permits accrued statutory travel expenses, so the residual classification preserves possible accrued rights without asserting that any particular unpaid claim exists. Selected OFR later-order search is bounded to its reported catalog/saved-text scope; the eCFR search reaches2026-10-14. USC119-121 is only current through2026-10-09 and is not asserted as a complete cutoff predicate. No human approval or publication is asserted.
